notes.title: Rock Simulator 2 Release Date + Price Adjustment
notes.notes:
[h1][b]ROCK SIMULATOR 2 RELEASE DATE[/b][/h1]

Nearly four years ago I created a silly little game with no reason or purpose. It was meant as a joke with an unlikely future. Thanks to each and every one of you I am here making a sequel that is bigger and better than the original. I have listened and learned along the way, adding many of the requested features and plenty more to come post-launch. 

I have a dream of developing games for the rest of my life, maybe more rock games lul, or a more serious title. Whatever it may be in the future I am thankful for YOU. 

[b]I am proud to announce the planned release date for Rock Simulator 2[/b]
[h3][b]NOVEMBER 30TH [/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949770/Rock_Simulator_2/

Adding the title to your wishlist is greatly appreciated. Tell all of your friends too! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Rock Simulator 2 Now Available for Wishlist!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

With Rock Simulator 2 now available for wishlist, let's talk about how the sequel has improved from the original and why you should consider adding it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1949770/Rock_Simulator_2/
[h4]LEVELING[/h4]
In the original Rock Simulator leveling was simple, you wait and earn stones to buy cosmetics. While this is still true in the sequel you will now be able to improve your leveling speed by upgrading each of your rocks from level 1 to 100, each level costing more than the previous. Everyone will start with a base level-up time of ten minutes and this can be improved significantly through rock leveling.

Expect more event periods with increased leveling speed! I now have the flexibility of introducing special events without the need for a client update.

[h4]LEADERBOARDS[/h4]
Rock Simulator 2 will come ready with a TOP 100 leaderboard to showcase those who have existed the longest. Be ready to optimize your rock leveling to jump to the top of the leaderboard!

[h4]MULTIPLAYER[/h4]
One of the most requested improvements from the original title was an increase in the number of players you can play with. I am happy to announce that you will be able to play with up to 8 players in any environment! The multiplayer chat has also seen a slight improvement from the original with more improvements expected after release.

[h4]STONES, OBSIDIAN, AND ATMOSPHERE[/h4]
You will be able to spend your hard-earned stones on rocks, rock variants, rock levels, environments, weather presets, and ambient sounds to adjust the atmosphere to your liking. Some of these items can also be purchased with the RM currency called obsidian if you don't feel like waiting like a true rock. NOTE: obsidian cannot be used in any way that will affect the player leaderboard, so rest assured it is for cosmetic items ONLY.

[h4]SETTINGS[/h4]
The sequel will come ready with video and graphics settings that will allow you to minimize (or maximize) your system usage.

THANK YOU ALL THAT HAVE SUPPORTED ME AND MY SILLY GAME! This is just the beginning for Rock Simulator 2 so please consider giving me feedback or ideas. ːsteamthumbsupː
-Park

notes.title: Rock Pass Is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes 11/27[/h1]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436660/Rock_Simulator__Rock_Pass/]Rock Pass Is Here![/url][/b][list]
[*] What is the Rock Pass? 
- The Rock Pass is a DLC that includes 30 levels for you to unlock through leveling up!
[*] What is included in the Rock Pass?
- 28 new skins that are unlocked through the Rock Pass (15 static and 13 animated)
- 2 new maps (Canyon and Bunker)
- 2 new puzzles for you to complete, each with their own reward!
[*] How do you progress through the Rock Pass?
- Rock Pass rewards are earned by leveling up! 30 rock levels = 1 Rock Pass level. It will roughly take around 40 minutes in playtime for each reward, so 20 hours in total to complete the Rock Pass
- [b]You will still earn Rock Pass progress even if you have not purchased it, but the items will not be usable until then.[/b]
[*] Pricing
- The Rock Pass is currently priced at $3.99 USD. You may be asking why is the Rock Pass twice the cost of the game itself?! The ultimate goal of this update is to allow Rock Simulator to go free-to-play in the future, while still gaining enough funds for a possible sequel to Rock Simulator.
[*] Will more content be added to the Rock Pass in the future?
- Yes! I will be adding content to the Rock Pass in future updates with new skins and maps! 
[*] Will you add achievements to the Rock Pass?
- Most likely no, with the reason being this version of the Rock Pass may not be available to all players in the future. For example, I may decide to retire this first Rock Pass (everyone who purchased it will keep the items obviously) and release a second version with brand new items and maps.
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer Improvements![/b][list]
[*] You can now click on a rock in a multiplayer session to view the user's profile. (This has been one of the most requested features!) 
You can toggle this off in the options menu if you keep bringing up users' profiles by accident.
[*] Hovering over a rock in a multiplayer session will now display the user's name and level
[*] The user's name will appear in gold if they have ascended and in red if they are over level 5000
[*] Updated the looks of the lobby selector
[*] The name of a multiplayer session will now appear in gold if the host of the lobby has ascended, and red if they are over level 5000
[*] You can now host private matches if you only want to rock with your friends
[*] Various multiplayer fixes
[/list]

*known issues (will be fixed ASAP)*
When clicking from the Rock Pass menu to the main menu it will mute the sound
The Sound will sometimes change volume when changing menus...weird

You can follow Rock Simulator on [url=https://twitter.com/RockSimulator]twitter[/url] for frequent updates!
Let me know your opinion on this update below! 
If you find any bugs feel free to message me on discord @Park#6615 or on Steam

Hello everyone, I just wanted to start by saying thank you so much for the amazing support on Rock Simulator! This is an unfortunate side effect of trying to improve the game but I promise it will be worth it <3. The multiplayer will be a max of 3 people and it will allow you to show off your hard-earned rock skins to anyone in the world! Oh.. and a few surprises are being added for the dedicated players :)
